about: Plate audit, 14-Oct (src/delivery/AUDIT-plates-14-Oct.md). Measured by building every car via render/showcar.js makeShowCar (traffic kinds via MODELS) headless. Coordinates: car-local metres, x across, y up, nose at +z; rear = -z. anchor = {yc: centre height, W: widest flat width at 0.12 m high, H: tallest flat height at min(W,0.52), z: face depth}. Classes: A flat 0.52 x 0.12 (3 cm / 8 deg), B flat 0.30 x 0.12, C only 0.30 x 0.10 under looser tolerance (8 cm / 25 deg), D none. Category: reliable (A or B), hand (C or D), cannot (craft, open-wheelers, bikes, saucers; a manual list).
